title: DkimSigner type spelled out verbosely at every call site — no type alias
description: The type Arc<mail_auth::dkim::DkimSigner<mail_auth::common::crypto::Ed25519Key, mail_auth::dkim::Done>> appears at 8+ locations across queue.rs, relay_queue.rs, main.rs (smtp), server_stores.rs. There is no type alias. If mail_auth ever changes the type signature (e.g. adds a generic parameter, or the Done state type moves), all 8 sites must be updated simultaneously. More immediately: a contributor adding a new code path will have to copy-paste this long type correctly. A type alias DkimSignerArc in one place makes this maintainable and searchable.
